purpose: Override evidence metadata for existing misconception records after targeted empirical review. This file changes evidence status/source attribution only; it does not replace the underlying instructional description.

overrides.note: Operational-versus-relational equal-sign reasoning is directly supported in a Grades 3-5 study. Do not infer prevalence in a jurisdiction or treat one MathBridge item as validated.
Whole-number digit-length interference is directly supported, but the verified school-age sample is Grade 7; use as a possible mechanism, not a primary prevalence claim.
Empirical studies document area/perimeter difficulty; samples are local and do not establish universal prevalence.
Grades 3-6 research documents inappropriate additive reasoning on proportional problems. Not every ratio error should be classified this way.
The study supports broader graph-interpretation difficulty, not the exact scale-assumed-one error.
Direct empirical support for the exact internal wording has not yet been verified.
Direct evidence for the exact internal-zero placeholder pattern remains pending.
Direct research supports side-length interference in angle-size judgement; retain age/sample limits.
Second-grade experiments directly support difficulty understanding ruler units as spatial intervals, especially on shifted-start tasks.
Direct Grades 2/4 evidence supports hand-specific difficulty and weak hour-minute relational reasoning, but not the exact same-scale wording.
Grade 6 evidence directly documents surface-area/volume confusion; do not generalise prevalence beyond the sample.
Keep as a probe until a checked study directly matches the unequal-sector/equiprobability claim.

resolver_rule: After resolving misconception aliases, merge an override by canonical misconception_id. resolved_status and evidence_level supersede catalog evidence metadata; source IDs are appended/deduplicated.
